> DEBIAN DSA                            
  Debian/DSA: Apache2 Flaws Patched     
                                        
  Debian released security update DSA   
  6620-1 for the Apache2 HTTP server    
  package across stable distributions.  
  System administrators are urged to    
  apply the latest package rebuilds to  
  prevent attacks.
